description.text:
Søstrene Grene makes a virtue of ensuring that you always have what you need for the home, for creative endeavours, and for the bigger and smaller celebrations of life. 

The Danish retail chain, established in 1973, offers a selection of small furniture, homeware, crafting items, and much more. With an ever-changing assortment, you can experience something new at every visit. 

Søstrene Grene not only aims to provide you with a shopping experience but also to lend you a moment to immerse yourself in the serenity of the wonderful world of Anna and Clara, just as they have been doing for the past 50 years. 

Visit the sisters’ wonderful world and experience the delight of the smaller things in life, for it is often those that bring the greatest joy.
